title: Paccheri alla Carbonara
description: A classic Italian pasta dish made with paccheri pasta, a rich and creamy sauce, and a hint of salty flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook paccheri pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat velvety bacon fat over medium heat.
Add grated parmesan cheese to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and slightly browned.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the cooked paccheri pasta to the bowl and toss with the egg mixture until well combined.
Add the melted parmesan cheese to the bowl and toss until the pasta is well coated.
Season with freshly ground pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Optional: add some crispy cooked bacon on top for an extra salty kick.
